column1: # GIGANTIC upload_manifest.tsv — secretome / STEP_1-build_evidence_table
# Publishes the per-species per-protein EVIDENCE TABLES produced by this
# workflow. Each evidence table is one wide TSV per species: one row per
# protein in the canonical proteome, with per-database annotation columns
# (Pfam, DeepLoc, MetaPredict, SignalP fast/slow, TMBed by default) pivoted
# out of the long-format standardized annotation database, augmented with the
# full DeepLoc per-compartment probability vector.
# These tables are the INPUT that STEP_2-filter_secretome consumes to call
# secreted proteins; they are published here so collaborators can inspect the
# raw per-protein evidence behind each secretome call.
# Mechanics: source_path is relative to the workflow-RUN_* directory holding
# this manifest. The shared helper (../../server/ai/update_upload_to_server.py,
# invoked by the subproject-root RUN-update_upload_to_server.sh) publishes the
# newest RUN per step into
# upload_to_server/STEP_1-build_evidence_table/workflow-RUN_*/.
# This is a COPYME template; it travels with the workflow into each
# workflow-RUN_* dir, where the helper picks it up.
source_path
# ----- Validated species proteome manifest (script 001) -----
OUTPUT_pipeline/1-output/1_ai-validated_manifest.tsv
column6: The validated species proteome manifest driving this run: species_name, proteome_path, phyloname for each of the 70 species.

column1: # ----- Per-species evidence tables (script 002; one per species, 70 total) -----
OUTPUT_pipeline/2-output/*_evidence_table.tsv
